categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Greenway Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of lithium-ion batteries and battery cells. Its main business segments include lightweight power batteries for electric two-wheel vehicles, energy storage batteries, consumer electronic batteries, and lithium-ion battery cells. The company also provides after-sales services and has a full industry chain layout from battery cells to battery packs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced lithium-ion battery technologies including full tab structure in 18 and 21 series cells, high-safety anti-propagation structural design, and intelligent battery management systems (BMS) for lifecycle management. It employs flexible manufacturing lines with digital production management systems, surface mount technology (SMT), and has capabilities in materials research, cell development, structural design, and battery pack assembly. The company is also developing solid-state and sodium-ion batteries and has proprietary technologies for low-temperature charging and long warranty manganese-based large cylindrical batteries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers of electric bicycles, electric motorcycles, consumer electronics, and energy storage systems. Major end markets are Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and domestic China, serving sectors such as electric two-wheel vehicles, portable and residential energy storage, and consumer electronics like laptops and drones. Strategic customers include Manufacture Francaise, Qilong Technology, Niu Technologies, and DJI.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D bases in Dongguan and Shenzhen. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Indonesia and Europe, focusing on Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, and Africa markets. The overseas presence supports local production and service capabilities, enhancing global competitiveness and mitigating regional demand fluctuations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Greenway operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium battery supply chain, producing battery cells, battery packs, and complete lithium-ion battery solutions. It sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers, including major cell suppliers like LG, Panasonic, and Samsung, and delivers finished battery products to OEM customers and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment (7.26% of revenue) focusing on improving energy density, safety, and lifecycle of lithium-ion batteries. Key R&D projects include advanced lithium-ion battery manufacturing technologies, high-voltage BMS platforms, new national standard BMS solutions, high-safety power batteries, medical oxygen machine battery systems, sodium-ion battery development, multi-pack battery systems, wireless charging battery packs, and liquid cooling anti-condensation technologies. It also emphasizes global expansion and localization of production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) contracts of lithium-ion battery products and battery cells. The company sells customized battery solutions to OEMs and distributors, with a mix of direct and agency sales channels. Revenue streams include product sales of lightweight power batteries, energy storage batteries, consumer electronic batteries, and lithium-ion cells.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Greenway is recognized as a leading player in China's lightweight lithium-ion battery sector, competing with other domestic and international battery manufacturers. It holds a strong market position in electric two-wheel vehicle batteries and consumer electronics batteries, supported by its comprehensive industry chain and technological capabilities. The company faces intense competition due to rapid industry growth and new entrants but maintains competitive advantages through innovation, flexible production, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.84 billion, a 17.48% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 96.6 million. Despite revenue decline due to market demand slowdown and pricing pressures, sales volumes increased across product lines. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.69 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.05 billion. R&D investment increased to RMB 134 million, reflecting a growth focus despite financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Greenway emphasizes delivering safe, efficient, and green energy solutions with customized lithium-ion battery products tailored to diverse customer needs. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced battery technologies, including high-safety designs, intelligent BMS, and flexible manufacturing capabilities enabling rapid product adaptation. The company’s global footprint and local production enhance responsiveness and service quality, while its comprehensive quality management system and certifications ensure product reliability and compliance with international standards.
